source_name: KvK Handelsregister Open Data Set — basis bedrijfsgegevens (anonymised bulk + HVDS API)
notes: EU High-Value DataSet (HVDS), CC-BY 4.0. Verified: downloaded the bulk CSV = 12.7 MB zip / 95 MB / 1,891,639 records. IMPORTANT: the BULK is ANONYMISED - NO KvK number, name, address or directors (only registration date, legal form, postcode region, SBI codes, active/insolvency). Statistical use. The HVDS API (opendata.kvk.nl) returns the same basic fields BY a supplied KvK number (free with an API key; rate-limited 429 without). Identified names/addresses/officers require the PAID KvK Handelsregister API.

source_name: KvK Handelsregister Open Data Set — jaarrekeningen (annual accounts, structured)
fields_observed: BalanceSheet (Assets, AssetsCurrent/Noncurrent, Equity, Liabilities, LiabilitiesMaturity<>1yr, Provisions, CalledUpShareCapital)
notes: STRUCTURED open annual-accounts data (XBRL-derived XML), CC-BY 4.0. Verified: downloaded jaarrekeningen ZIP 0 = 200 MB containing many individual OpendataJaarrekening_{year}_{hash}.xml files (one report each), with balance-sheet figures (Assets, Equity, Liabilities, Provisions, share capital) + financial year. Split into multiple ZIPs (0..5+). IMPORTANT: the BULK is ANONYMISED - NO KvK number/name (SBI code + figures + year only). The HVDS API returns a company's jaarrekening BY KvK number (free with key). EUR.

source_name: KvK Handelsregister API (Zoeken / Basisprofiel / Vestigingsprofiel / Naamgeving)
notes: The PAID official Handelsregister API: Zoeken (search by name/number), Basisprofiel (full company profile incl. KvK-nummer, RSIN, names, addresses, officers), Vestigingsprofiel (establishments), Naamgeving (names/trademarks). Requires an API key + paid subscription (free test environment). The route to IDENTIFIED data (names, addresses, officers) that the open data strips. Keyed on KvK-nummer (8 digits).

fields_observed: beneficial owners (name, nationality, month/year of birth, nature/extent of interest)
notes: Register of ultimate beneficial owners. General public access suspended after the Nov 2022 CJEU ruling; access for AML-obliged entities, expanded via the KvK API from April 2026 (API-UBO 2.0 JSON planned 2027). Not open bulk. Join on KvK-nummer/RSIN. Personal data (GDPR). Noted for completeness.
Dutch VAT number (btw-nummer) = NL + 9 digits + B + 2 (for legal entities, the 9 digits = RSIN). Not in the open KvK data. Validate via VIES. Validation/enrichment only; does not enumerate companies.

National open-data portal (CKAN). Verified working: catalogs the KvK open datasets (basis bedrijfsgegevens, jaarrekeningen; CC-BY 4.0) and links to the kvk.nl downloads + opendata.kvk.nl HVDS APIs. Discovery hub; the authoritative downloads are on kvk.nl / opendata.kvk.nl.

Vendors (Company.info, Graydon/CreditSafe, Kyckr) resell the KvK register + identified company data + parsed financials + credit. A path to IDENTIFIED bulk + structured financials at scale (alongside the paid KvK API), since the open KvK data is anonymised. Proprietary, paid, per contract.
